svg.title: Unrelated risk alerts combine into one market shortage forecast.
svg.desc: Clinic, welfare, address, and flood-risk cards join into a red bundle and travel through the Crosswalk. In the distance, market stock icons and price slates begin changing before any physical shortage exists.
svg.text: Page 37, panel 5 · Network pull-back from the flagged correction towards the market
